title: Concept: Overly open CORS (go) — review required
description: In go, AllowOrigins[^n]** lets foreign origins read responses. Wildcard origins combine dangerously with credentialed requests. The remedy is an explicit origin list (an explicit origin list).
applicability: go API servers and middleware; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-origin data theft where credentials apply; MEDIUM severity.
